questions.question: Which of the following is a fundamental unit? निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी मूल इकाई है?
questions.solution:
• Metre is a fundamental unit for length in the SI system.

• Newton is a derived unit of force.

• Joule is a derived unit of energy.

• Pascal is a derived unit of pressure.

Further Insight:

• Units

• A unit is a fixed standard quantity used to measure other quantities of the same kind.

• Types of Units:

○ Fundamental Units: Cannot be expressed in terms of other physical quantities. Examples: Length (meter), Mass (kilogram), Time (second), etc.

○ Derived Units: Derived from fundamental units. Examples: Area (square meter), Volume (cubic meter), Force (newton).

• Volt is a derived unit for electric potential (voltage).

• Kilogram is a fundamental unit for mass.

• Second is a fundamental unit for time.

• Ampere is a fundamental unit for electric current.

Further Insight:

• Units

• A unit is a fixed standard quantity used to measure other quantities of the same kind.

• Types of Units:

○ Fundamental Units: Cannot be expressed in terms of other physical quantities. Examples: Length (meter), Mass (kilogram), Time (second), etc.

○ Derived Units: Derived from fundamental units. Examples: Area (square meter), Volume (cubic meter), Force (newton).

• In the CGS system, mass is measured in grams.

• In the MKS system and SI system, mass is measured in kilograms.

• In the FPS system, mass is measured in pounds.

Further Insight:

• Earlier systems of Measurement included:

○ CGS System: Length in centimeters, mass in grams, time in seconds.

○ MKS System: Length in meters, mass in kilograms, time in seconds.

○ FPS System: Length in feet, mass in pounds, time in seconds.

• SI Units: The most widely used system today, providing consistency across scientific disciplines.

questions.question: Which prefix represents a factor of 10⁶ ? कौन सा उपसर्ग 10⁶ के गुणनखंड को दर्शाता है?

1.496 X 10¹¹ m1.496 x 10¹¹ मी
3.00 X 10⁸ m/s3.00 x 10⁸ मी/से

questions.solution:
• 1 light year is approximately 9.46 X 10¹⁵ meters.

• 3.26 X 10¹⁶ meters refers to parsec.

• 1.496 X 10¹¹ meters refers to an astronomical unit.

• 3.00 X 10⁸ m/s is the speed of light in m/s.

Further Insight:

• Astronomical Unit (AU): Mean distance between Earth and Sun.

○ 1 AU = 1.496 X 10¹¹ m.

• Light Year: Distance light travels in one year.

○ 1 Light Year = 9.46 X 10¹⁵ m.

• Parsec: Used for measuring distances outside the solar system.

○ 1 Parsec = 3.26 light years = 3.08 X 10¹⁶ m.

questions.question: '1 Parsec' is equivalent to how many light years? '1 पारसेक' कितने प्रकाश वर्ष के बराबर है?
questions.solution:
• 1 Parsec equals approximately 3.26 light years.

• 1.496 X 10¹¹ (1) is the value of an astronomical unit.

• 9.46 X 10¹⁵ (3) is the distance for a light year.

• 3.00 X 10⁸ (4) is the speed of light in meters per second.

Further Insight:

• Astronomical Unit (AU): Mean distance between Earth and Sun.

○ 1 AU = 1.496 X 10¹¹ m.

• Light Year: Distance light travels in one year.

○ 1 Light Year = 9.46 X 10¹⁵ m.

• Parsec: Used for measuring distances outside the solar system.

○ 1 Parsec = 3.26 light years = 3.08 X 10¹⁶ m.

• Screw gauge is used to measure small lengths up to 10⁻⁵ meters.

• Meter scale measures length up to 10⁻² meters.

• Vernier calipers measure length up to 10⁻⁴ meters.

• Spherometer measures small lengths but is mainly used for spherical objects.

• 1 liter of water has a mass of 1 kg when measured at its maximum density, which is around 4 degree celsius.

Further Insight:

• Mass of Water:

○ 1 mL of water = 1 g.

○ 1 L of water = 1 kg.

• Amount of Water in Different Volumes

○ 1 cubic centimeter (1 cm≥)

■ 1 cm≥ = 1 milliliter (ml)

■ 1 cm≥ of water weighs approximately 1 gram (g).

○ 1 cubic meter (1 m≥)

■ 1 m≥ = 1000 liters (L)

■ 1 m≥ of water weighs approximately 1000 kilograms (kg) or 1 metric tonne.
